title: Quranic verses calling the world a game
summary: Rizwan Virk tells of Quranic verses calling the world a game, about 7th century at Islamic tradition, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: But in the Islamic traditions, there's actual verses that say, "We have set up this world for you as a game, as a pastime, as a sport."

plain: Rizwan Virk, a scientist who argues that we may live in a kind of computer simulation or hologram, told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, that Islamic tradition has verses saying, "We have set up this world for you as a game, as a pastime, as a sport." He credits these to the Quran, Islam's holy book, and offers them as an ancient echo of the idea that our reality is a built game.
